MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The outlet extender feels useful because I have repeatedly bought power strips and charging cables, and its spaced outlets and USB ports serve those same practical needs.",
    "The TV mount could help me position my existing 32-inch TV, provided its mounting pattern and weight are compatible."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Owning a TV does not mean I currently want a streaming device, and my listed 720p TV gives me little reason to seek 4K features or Dolby Vision.",
    "My photography accessories do not imply a need for home surveillance, and my tablet purchase does not imply interest in smart displays or voice assistants.",
    "Buying memory cards does not establish a need for a 16TB hard drive, and nothing in my recent activity suggests a desktop WiFi problem."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire tablet seems to have been taken as interest in a broader collection of Amazon devices, although my related purchases were practical accessories.",
    "My electronics purchases seem to have been treated as a general desire for more electronics, without enough attention to the particular job each purchase served."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I repeatedly buy accessories that support equipment I already own, such as cables, mounts, memory-card holders, and power strips.",
    "Specific compatibility matters to me: the right connector, mounting pattern, storage format, or fit is more useful than a broadly related device.",
    "My frequent purchases do not mean I need every kind of upgrade; a new device should address a clear use or problem."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You partly recognized my need for practical accessories, but inferred too much interest in new devices from the electronics I already own."
}
